Enhancement Quality is mild, ET Volume (mL) is extremely small, and Proportion Enhancing is very low, which argues against the typical strongly enhancing phenotype of many IDH-wildtype glioblastomas. Against IDH-mutant status, Deep WM invasion, substantial ED Volume (mL), high Proportion of Oedema, high Proportion Necrosis, and large Total tumor volume (mL) raise concern for more aggressive biology that can be seen with IDH-wildtype disease. Overall, the younger age, frontal-cortical location, and minimal enhancement outweigh the aggressive-size/edema features, so the best estimate is IDH-mutant.
